panels.title: Class-probability mixture on the PCA plane

0,0.note: PCA and logistic regression are fitted on training data only. Each grid point is lifted from the selected two-PC plane into the full feature space before prediction. The color mixture uses all class probabilities; a projected test point need not have the same prediction as its affine-plane lift.
